mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 5.0% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate accelerates monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the signal in high inflation periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) falls below 0.5% annualized, it signals a slowing economy that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls from the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE below 3.5%), a further decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC for the signal in low unemployment periods is below 0.03.
